    "Model forecasts are systematically below true outcomes, showing a consistent under-forecast bias of approximately 0.5-1.0 on average",

    "Model fails to capture sentiment-driven price momentum, especially during sharp sentiment shifts",
    "Price mean-reversion is absent in forecasts as prices continue trending when sentiment is positive",
    "Forecast lag is evident, with model responses delayed relative to actual price and sentiment changes",
    "Sentiment strength doesn't linearly translate to forecast adjustments, showing non-linear interaction effects",
    "Model over-corrects when prices decline, producing forecasts that are too low relative to true values"
